title: Integration & System Transaction Rules
communication_boundary: Modules MUST communicate exclusively through approved shared interfaces (.ai/contracts/shared-interfaces.json) and logical API contracts (.ai/contracts/api-contracts.json).
No module may directly read or mutate undocumented internal data structures, private variables, or UI state of another module.
transaction_sequence: Step 3: Staff reviews and Confirms Reservation + Creates Event Schedule (Module 04)
Step 4: System creates Catering Order (Module 07 / Milestone)
Step 5: Operational Sub-processes (Inventory Deduction, Payment Recording, Equipment Release)
sequence_constraints: A Catering Order CANNOT be created before its parent Reservation is formally confirmed by authorized staff.
Inventory reservation/deduction, payment transactions, and equipment dispatch CANNOT occur without an active, confirmed Catering Order.
history_append_only_enforcement: Inventory Movements: Every stock addition, reservation, or deduction MUST append a new record to Inventory Movement.
Payment Transactions: Every deposit or payment MUST append a new record to Payment Transaction.
Audit Trails: Every protected system action MUST append a record to Audit Trail.
historical_snapshot_preservation: When a master record (Catering Package, Menu Item, Inventory Item) is updated, previous completed or confirmed orders MUST preserve their original historical price and name snapshots.
schedule_conflict_prevention: Date availability checks and schedule creation MUST validate against approved Event Schedule records associated with confirmed reservations. Overlapping date-time ranges MUST be rejected.
report_generation_isolation: Report Generation (Module 09) is strictly a read-only consumer of source transaction entities. It MUST NOT modify, insert, or delete source records.
